scope: Primary sources only. These references do not replace local GPU evidence.

sources.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
sources.claim: Shared recurrent weights permit work at different loop depths to share a recurrent batch. The evaluated shared-KV and adaptive-depth settings do not qualify the present fixed-R32, exact per-depth KV contract.
sources.use: Prior-art boundary and architecture explanation, not a new measured speedup.

sources.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness
sources.claim: Fixed-batch arithmetic preservation differs from changed batching, noise, and packed-prefill arithmetic. Generic runtime costs need symmetric treatment before a Loop-specific PD claim.
sources.use: Exactness and baseline limits. The paper's performance numbers are not copied into our result tables.

sources.title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
sources.claim: Decode-side slack and pressure-aware bounded Prefill work transfer are generic PD mechanisms.
sources.use: Novelty boundary. Our earlier Token arm remains a FluidToken-style reproduction, not an official FluidPD result.

sources.title: PyTorch Pipeline Parallelism
sources.claim: General model execution can be partitioned into stages with microbatch scheduling and data-flow dependencies.
sources.use: General stage-partition concept only. Not evidence of an implemented Decode-safe adaptive Layer PD baseline.
